world.title: ‘Mr Munir, you are fired’: Iranian journalist slams Pakistan army chief, says PM Modi has ‘changed the game’
world.summary: At the BRICS Summit in New Delhi, Iranian journalist Basim Laleh criticized Pakistan and Army Chief Asim Munir, stating that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has significantly altered the regional dynamics. Laleh highlighted India's increasing diplomatic influence in contrast to Pakistan's performance, emphasizing the shift in power and perception within the region during his remarks at the summit.

world.title: Trump’s successor race is heating up: JD Vance leads the GOP field, but the president says ‘it’s too early’
world.summary: JD Vance is currently the frontrunner for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, according to early assessments. However, former President Donald Trump has stated that it is premature to endorse any candidate at this stage. Meanwhile, the current vice president is delaying any announcements regarding his own candidacy until after the 2026 midterm elections conclude.

world.title: Shot down in Iran, hunted for 50 hours: New details emerge on US rescue op for Air Force officers Alpha, Bravo
world.summary: A newly declassified video has disclosed details of a US military operation aimed at rescuing an Air Force officer who was shot down in Iran. The operation lasted nearly 50 hours and involved significant risks. The video highlights the challenges faced during the mission, showcasing the efforts made to locate and extract the officer from hostile territory.

business.title: Gold slips below Rs 1.51 lakh, silver falls nearly 2% on MCX as Fed rate cut hopes fade
business.summary: Gold prices fell below Rs 1.51 lakh, while silver declined nearly 2% on the MCX, influenced by stronger-than-expected US inflation, a firmer dollar, and rising Treasury yields. These factors have heightened expectations for a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve rate hike this week. Market volatility was also affected by escalating Middle East tensions and increasing oil prices.

business.title: These 3 Pipeline Stocks Pay High Yields Without the K-1 Headache
business.summary: Pipeline stocks offer high yields and stable cash flow, attracting investors seeking passive income without the complexities of K-1 tax forms. Three C-corp operators provide fee-based revenue across commodity cycles, making them appealing for those looking to diversify income sources. This investment strategy helps mitigate financial stress from job loss or unexpected expenses, enhancing overall financial security.

business.title: Mobile phone makers seek GST cut from 18% to 5% as rising handset prices hit demand
business.summary: Mobile phone manufacturers, represented by the India Cellular and Electronics Association (ICEA), are advocating for a reduction in the Goods and Services Tax (GST) on smartphones from 18% to 5%. They argue that the rising prices of handsets are negatively impacting consumer demand. The industry body is also requesting a corresponding GST adjustment for mobile phone components.

technology.title: Apple Foldable iPhone Could Change Smartphones Forever
technology.summary: Apple has introduced the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, priced at $1,999. Bloomberg Strategist Mark Gurman suggests this device could make foldable smartphones mainstream due to its advanced hardware, software, and durability. The iPhone Duo was unveiled on September 9, 2023, marking a significant development in smartphone technology and potentially transforming consumer expectations in the market.

technology.title: Google’s AI-Mapped fruit fly brain has tried "Doom" 6,000+ times without winning- Here's what happened!
technology.summary: Google researchers have mapped over 166,000 neurons in a fruit fly's brain and connected it to the video game Doom. The digital brain attempted to play the game 6,385 times but did not achieve any victories. This research aims to explore the cognitive capabilities of the fruit fly and the potential applications of AI in understanding complex neural networks.

technology.title: XBOX CEO Asha Sharma is Reportedly Handling Customer Support Tickets
technology.summary: Asha Sharma, the new CEO of XBOX, is reportedly engaging directly with customer support by handling tickets. Since her appointment, she has implemented changes to XBOX Games Pass and focused on revitalizing the XBOX brand. This hands-on approach in customer service reflects her commitment to addressing user concerns and enhancing the overall customer experience within the gaming community.

sports.title: Kranti Gaud fined for breaching ICC code of conduct during Asia Cup final
sports.summary: India's Kranti Gaud has been fined 10% of her match fees for breaching the ICC Code of Conduct during the Women’s T20 Asia Cup final against Sri Lanka. The incident occurred in the opening over when Gaud gave a send-off to Imesha Dulani. This violation falls under Article 2.5, categorized as a Level 1 offence.

sports.title: Kranti Gaud fined for breaching ICC code of conduct during Asia Cup final
sports.summary: India's Kranti Gaud has been fined 10% of her match fees for breaching the ICC Code of Conduct during the Women’s T20 Asia Cup final in Dubai on September 13. The incident occurred in the first over of Sri Lanka's chase when Gaud gave a send-off to Imesha Dulani, resulting in a Level 1 offence under Article 2.5.

sports.title: Sydney Sweeney reacts to backlash over sports ad with cryptic Instagram posts
sports.summary: Sydney Sweeney has addressed backlash regarding her recent Novig sports advertisement, which features her nude. The ad has faced criticism from athletes and social media users, igniting a broader discussion on the portrayal of women's bodies in sports advertising. Sweeney's responses on Instagram have been cryptic, reflecting her attempt to navigate the controversy surrounding the campaign.

health.title: India Surpasses 80 Lakh HPV Vaccine Doses Under Nationwide Campaign
health.summary: India has administered over 80 lakh human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine doses as part of its nationwide campaign. This achievement highlights the country's efforts to enhance preventive healthcare and provide protection against HPV infections and related cancers. The initiative aims to improve public health outcomes and reduce the incidence of HPV-associated diseases across the population.

health.title: Here's how to catch up on sleep, the right way
health.summary: Two hours of extra sleep can help mitigate the effects of a poor night’s rest. However, it is important to approach early nights and lie-ins with caution to avoid disrupting sleep patterns. While catching up on sleep can be beneficial, moderation is key to maintaining overall sleep health and ensuring that the body adjusts properly.

science.title: Is there a hidden 'Planet 9' in our solar system?
science.summary: Astronomers have long speculated about the existence of a hidden planet, often referred to as "Planet 9," in the outer regions of our solar system. This hypothetical planet has intrigued scientists for over a century, leading to various search efforts and theories. Despite extensive research, definitive evidence of its existence remains elusive, leaving the mystery unsolved.

science.title: Scientists Turn Ordinary Light Into a Quantum Machine
science.summary: LSU researchers have developed a quantum reservoir using bright laser light and photon-counting detectors, enabling it to simulate complex dynamics and learn tasks. This advancement addresses the fragility of quantum systems, which are sensitive to disturbances and noise. The new technology aims to enhance the potential of quantum computers, which could outperform traditional supercomputers in solving complex problems.

science.title: Extreme heat events becoming more common beyond summer months, study finds
science.summary: A recent study published in AGU Advances reveals that extreme heat events are increasingly occurring in the months before and after summer. Researchers found a global trend of rising temperatures outside traditional summer months, indicating a significant expansion of extreme heat occurrences. This shift raises concerns about climate change impacts and the need for adaptive measures in various regions.

entertainment.title: This actor became a national crush with her Bollywood debut but quit films to build a brand with millionaire husband
entertainment.summary: Sandali Sinha made her Bollywood debut in 2001 with the film Tum Bin, quickly gaining popularity. However, she chose to leave the film industry to focus on family life, becoming a mother of two. Sinha co-founded a dessert brand with her millionaire husband, shifting her career from acting to entrepreneurship while maintaining a private family life.

entertainment.title: Kangana Ranaut hits back at Rakhi Sawant after her comments on her, Smriti Irani: 'All your favours combined never got you even a sweeper's job'
entertainment.summary: Kangana Ranaut responded to Rakhi Sawant's controversial remarks about her and Smriti Irani. In her rebuttal, Ranaut labeled Sawant as "unsuccessful and bitter," asserting that all of Sawant's efforts combined had not secured her even a basic job. This exchange highlights ongoing tensions between the two public figures within the entertainment and political spheres.

entertainment.title: Sydney Sweeney reacts to backlash over sports ad with cryptic Instagram posts
entertainment.summary: Sydney Sweeney has faced backlash for her Novig sports advertisement, which features her nude and has drawn criticism from athletes and social media users. The controversy has sparked a broader discussion about the representation of women's bodies in sports advertising. In response, Sweeney has shared cryptic posts on Instagram, seemingly addressing the criticism without providing specific comments.
